fields.description: Base domain of regional services, such as frappe.dev.
fields.label: Wildcard Domain

fields.description: This Central's ID in Atlas webhooks. Keep 1 unless several Centrals share one Atlas.
fields.label: Central ID

fields.description: The name and logo customers see in the console, emails and messages.
fields.label: Brand

fields.description: The product name customers see. Leave empty to use Intrakore Cloud.
fields.label: Brand Name

fields.description: A square logo. Upload a public file, because an email client loads it without a session. Leave empty to use the INTRAKORE logo.
fields.label: Brand Logo

fields.description: The terms and policies page linked from sign-in and signup. Leave empty to hide the notice.
fields.label: Policies URL

fields.description: The helpdesk customer portal's new ticket page, such as https://support.example.com/helpdesk/my-tickets/new. Leave empty to hide Contact support.
fields.label: Support Ticket URL

fields.description: Feedback form opened from the console Help menu. Leave empty to hide Share feedback.
fields.label: Feedback URL

fields.description: Raven incoming webhook for infrastructure alerts that the investigator sends.
fields.label: Infra Alert Webhook URL

fields.description: Raven incoming webhook for infrastructure reports that the investigator sends.
fields.label: Infra Report Webhook URL

fields.description: Shows Add-ons in the console navigation.
fields.label: Enable Add-ons
Networking
fields.description: Options on the New server page. An option that is off is hidden and refused.

Customers get their sites and products only. SSH keys, the web console, the bench admin (Open server), WireGuard, firewall and public addresses, snapshots, resizing and the image catalog are for System Managers. A customer signs in to a site as their own user. Turn it off for a self-serve console.
fields.label: Managed SaaS Mode

fields.description: A paid server needs a payment method or enough credit. Turn off for demos.
fields.label: Require Payment Method

fields.description: The monthly transfer the console shows for every server. Central does not limit or bill it.
fields.label: Included Transfer (GB)

fields.description: Prefer the newest signup image at least this old, to allow host caching. Use the latest if none qualifies. 0 selects the latest.
fields.label: Signup Image Minimum Age (Minutes)
Server Limits
fields.description: Every new server gets these limits, so one server cannot use all of its host's disk or network.
Disk operations per second.
fields.label: Disk IOPS

fields.description: Disk read and write speed.
fields.label: Disk Throughput (MiB/s)

fields.description: Traffic within the region.
fields.label: Private Network Throughput (MiB/s)

fields.description: Traffic to and from the internet.
fields.label: Public Network Throughput (MiB/s)

fields.description: JSON merged into each new server's common_site_config.json. Customers can read it, so add no secrets.
fields.label: Common Site Config

fields.description: Days an invitation stays open. Resending restarts the count.
fields.label: Invitation Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Per sender. Operators have no limit.
fields.label: Invitations per Hour

fields.description: Wait before a pending invitation can be sent again.
fields.label: Invitation Resend Cooldown (Minutes)

fields.description: Codes expire after the email link expiry in System Settings.
fields.label: Sign-in Codes

fields.description: Wrong codes before the email is locked until the code expires.
fields.label: Code Attempts

fields.description: Codes one email can request before the code expires.
fields.label: Codes per Email

fields.description: A trial runs for Trial Days, then stops. After Trial Deletion Days, its server is terminated. Upgrading keeps the site.
fields.label: Trial Period

fields.label: Trial Days

fields.description: Days a stopped trial is kept before its server is terminated. A Product can override it.
fields.label: Trial Deletion Days

fields.description: Days before the trial ends, or before deletion, to send a warning email.
fields.label: Trial Notice Days

fields.description: Trial servers use the cheapest plan marked Available on Trial. Billing Settings holds the welcome credit.
fields.label: Trial Server

fields.description: Open trial sites per owner, across teams. For a staging trial team, servers per team.
fields.label: Trial Servers Limit

fields.description: Idle minutes before a trial server sleeps. 0 keeps it awake.
fields.label: Trial Idle Shutdown (Minutes)

fields.description: The free trial that the sign-in page offers, and that the /try link opens.
fields.label: Trial Signup

fields.description: The product of the free trial, such as crm-estimation. Leave empty to send /try to the plain signup and hide the trial link on the sign-in page.
fields.label: Default Trial Product

fields.description: Placeholder prices for the onboarding seat counter and plan summary. Seat billing does not read them yet.
fields.label: Seat Pricing

fields.description: The currency of the seat and storage prices.
fields.label: Seat Price Currency

fields.description: The monthly price of one seat after the trial.
fields.label: Seat Price

fields.description: The base plan bills at least this many seats.
fields.label: Included Seats

fields.description: The monthly price of 1 GB of storage above the plan.
fields.label: Storage Price per GB

fields.description: The free AI budget of a trial site.
fields.label: Trial AI Cap

fields.description: The badges, benefit lines and quote of the onboarding pages. Only true claims. Leave empty to use the defaults in central/signups/onboarding.py. A key set here replaces the default of that key.
fields.label: Trust Content

fields.description: Pilot clones private repositories with this App. Create GitHub App fills these fields.
fields.label: GitHub App
Trial Invitations
fields.description: Operators invite people from the Trial Invitation list or the invitation API. Each invitation emails a one-time activation link.
A new email needs a live Trial Invitation or a pending team invitation to sign up. The public signup page and the /try link are off. Existing users still sign in.
fields.label: Invite Only

fields.description: Days an activation link stays open. Resending restarts the count.
fields.label: Trial Invitation Expiry (Days)
